content.short: Ramp is a US finance platform with corporate cards, expense management, bill pay and procurement.
content.description: Ramp, founded in 2019, is a US financial platform focused on helping companies control and reduce spend through corporate cards and automation. It offers corporate and virtual cards, expense management, bill pay, accounts payable, procurement, travel booking and treasury, tied together with AI automation and accounting integrations that categorize transactions and flag savings. Ramp's model centers on helping finance teams spend less rather than more, using software to automate approvals, close the books faster and surface waste. Trusted by tens of thousands of businesses from startups to larger enterprises, it works as an all-in-one finance operations platform where cards, payments and expense workflows generate the data that drives control.
